title: Behavior artifact comparison
responsibility: Reads and verifies behavior artifacts, then compares recorded content while excluding explicitly declared run metadata.

inputs.name: artifactDifferences.before
inputs.description: Earlier recorded value: a parsed document, or the text of a result that is not one. An object whose harnessRun declares version 1 has its recognized run metadata set aside before the comparison; anything else is compared as it is.

inputs.name: artifactDifferences.after
inputs.description: Later recorded value: a parsed document, or the text of a result that is not one. It is prepared the same way as the earlier value, so the two are compared on what each holds.

inputs.name: explorerReading.behavior
inputs.description: Behavior comparison to resolve, as explorerBehavior builds it: rows with their before and after captures (null where a side is missing or not usable), plus the summary and reason it was given. Its mode and scenarios are returned unchanged.

examples.reason: The recorded results differ in bytes; reading them says whether the behaviour does.

inputs.name: explorerReading.mediaBase
inputs.description: Prefix of the console's protected media path: each capture's file name, which is its media value without the leading media/, is appended to it directly, so it must end in /. The console builds it as its base followed by /media/.

inputs.name: explorerReading.fetcher
inputs.description: Optional loader that takes an artifact address and resolves to a value with ok, status and arrayBuffer; it is called at most once per distinct SHA-256 in one explorerReading call, and only for captures with a stored media file. When it is undefined, explorerArtifact falls back to fetch(address).

outputs.name: artifactRun
outputs.type: { readonly field: "harnessRun"; readonly version: 1; readonly metadata: readonly string[]; }
outputs.description: The run-declaration constant: the field name harnessRun, version 1, and the five keys a declaration may set aside as metadata (startedAt, finishedAt, at, durationMs and pid). A declared key whose value is not of its kind (a time as a string or number, a duration or process id as a number) stays in the declaration and is compared.

outputs.name: artifactDifferences
outputs.description: The paths at which the two values differ, such as output.total or trace[2].durationMs; arrays are compared by index, objects by the sorted union of their keys, and a difference in the whole value is the empty string. Recognized run metadata is set aside only inside a supported harnessRun declaration, at the root or on trace entries when the root has one, so undeclared times and process IDs count as behavior.

outputs.name: explorerReading
outputs.description: The resolved behavior, with beforeRead and afterRead set on every row; a row whose bytes differ becomes changed or unchanged by what they hold, and a row with an unverified read becomes unknown. A not-compared summary, or an unknown summary with a reason, is retained; otherwise the summary is unknown with a fixed reason when any read is unverified, and is recomputed from the rows when none is.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Rejects with whatever the artifact loader, the read of a response's bytes or the SHA-256 digest rejects with, such as a failed fetch. explorerReading does not catch it, so one such rejection rejects the whole result.
